parameters.formTitle: Talent Insights â Applicant CSV Analyzer
parameters.formDescription: Upload an applicants CSV (name, phone, email, city, current CTC, skills). Your talent-analysis report appears on screen right after you submit.

parameters.text:
=You are a technical recruiter assistant. Return valid json only.
For each applicant, assign exactly ONE skill_category from this fixed list based on their skills:
Web Development, AI Automation, Python Developer, AI Engineer, .NET Developer, DevOps Engineer, Data Engineer, QA/Automation, Full Stack.
Then compute category_distribution (count per category actually used) and write a short recruiter-facing insights narrative referencing these aggregate stats: {{ JSON.stringify($json.stats) }}.
Applicants (json array): {{ JSON.stringify($json.forLlm) }}

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: {"tagged":[{"name":"Jane Doe","skill_category":"AI Automation"}],"category_distribution":[{"category":"AI Automation","count":3}],"insights":"A concise 3-5 sentence recruiter-facing narrative summarizing the talent pool."}
